headline: Munar beats No. 10 Fritz in the Kinoshita Group Japan Open Tennis Championships round 1
dek: Munar won 6-7(7), 6-4, 6-3 in the round 1 of Kinoshita Group Japan Open Tennis Championships.

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Jaume Munar, ranked No. 66, beat Taylor Fritz (No. 10) 6-7(7), 6-4, 6-3 in the round 1 of Kinoshita Group Japan Open Tennis Championships in Tokyo.

sections.heading: Why it mattered
paragraphs: On the ATP singles list in the PropBetEdge archive in force when the tournament began, Munar was ranked No. 66 and Fritz No. 10.
It was Munar's 3rd win of the tournament.

sections.heading: What comes next
paragraphs: Munar plays Jaime Faria in the round 2.
